title: How the World Works
overview: Despite his best efforts, level 999 villager Kagami gets involved in a quest to hunt the Demon King.

title: The Ultimate Idiot
overview: Kagami agrees to help Alice and introduces her to a friend.

title: Demon and Human Coexistence
overview: Kagami foils a demonic attack on the city and learns about darker forces at play.

title: I Have Questions for You
overview: As monsters attack Salmaria, the Hero's party begins to doubt their convictions.

title: Assigned Roles
overview: The battle for Salmaria seems to be going well, until an unexpected visitor drops in.

title: Her Highness's Thinking
overview: Kagami and his friends kick off a new adventure: trying to start a casino in Valman!

title: You're Changed by the People You Meet
overview: An unexpected new ally has contributed to the casino's opening, but trouble is brewing behind the scenes.

title: Incompatible
overview: While Kagami and Menow pursue a quicker way to earn money, Alice struggles with suspicions back in Valman.

title: Hope Like Never Before
overview: At the end of a mysterious dungeon, Kagami and Menow learn more than they expected.

title: Damned Ideas of Common Sense
overview: The heroes regroup and plot their next course of action in light of recent events.

title: The King's Authority Is Absolute
overview: Kagami and friends storm the castle to try to negotiate with the king, but find Parna waiting for them.
